$comment: The verb suite's checks (ui/scripts/verbs.mjs, which `just ui-test` runs beside interactions.mjs): one for each verb here, seat of `moment` and layout, logged as `verb:<verb>/<seat>/<layout>` and named so to `just ui-test` to run it alone. `moment` is what they all watch, a permanent cast, its enters trigger and the tokens it makes (the board combat-declare's Overlord of the Mistmoors), as fixtures of ui/fixtures.json for each seat: `whole`, the moment in one view, as a seat with nothing to answer gets it, and `cut`, the same play cut into a view at each priority (full-control stops). A verb listed here has a case of its name in verbs.mjs, and a layout an entry of its name in that script's LAYOUTS: the windows it is checked at (a phone's are the phone sizes of ui/shots.json) and what differs in it.
